stem.text: What is correct for phloem sieve tube elements?

A.text: Companion cells provide structural support to the phloem sieve tube elements.

B.text: Lignified walls of phloem sieve tube elements prevent transport of mineral salts by mass flow.

C.text: Phloem sieve tube elements become narrower as movement of sucrose occurs.

D.text: Plasmodesmata allow movement of water and solutes across cell walls of phloem sieve tube elements.
